summary.headline: A good month for career · Venus turns retrograde in Libra
summary.narrative: Asha, October is shaped most by Saturn in your 4th from Moon ("Kantaka Shani: home and peace"). Your strongest area is career. Sun transiting your 10th from Moon (career, status and reputation) supports your career. Watch for Tula Sankranti (17 Oct) and Jupiter enters Leo (31 Oct). Your Rahu-Venus dasha keeps love, comfort, creativity, luxury and partnerships in focus.

keyTransits.title: Saturn in your 4th from Moon
keyTransits.simple: Saturn is testing your patience with your home and family life
keyTransits.meaning: Kantaka Shani: home and peace. Saturn in the 4th from your Moon (Kantaka or Ardhashtama Shani) can bring pressure at home, property issues and inner restlessness. Stability comes from patience and simple routines.
realLife: Home may need repairs, or you may relocate.
Your mother or family elders may need care.
You may feel emotionally distant or unsettled.
Work-life balance becomes a challenge.

keyTransits.title: Jupiter in your 9th from Moon
keyTransits.simple: Jupiter blesses your luck, travel and elders
keyTransits.meaning: Fortune and grace. Jupiter in the 9th from your Moon is excellent: luck, blessings from elders, spiritual growth and long-distance opportunities increase.
realLife: Long-distance travel or pilgrimage is favoured.
Mentors and elders support you.
Higher studies and religious activities bring fulfilment.
Luck seems to work in your favour.

keyTransits.title: Rahu in your 3rd from Moon
keyTransits.simple: Rahu boosts ambition in your efforts, short trips and siblings
keyTransits.meaning: Bold moves succeed. Rahu in the 3rd from your Moon is one of its best placements. Courage, media, technology and bold initiatives tend to succeed, and you can outmanoeuvre obstacles.
realLife: You feel brave enough to take calculated risks and promote yourself.
Media, writing, sales, marketing or tech projects gain traction.
Short trips and new contacts bring openings.
You find clever workarounds for problems that used to block you.
doList: Launch bold initiatives and pitch ideas

keyTransits.title: Ketu in your 9th from Moon
keyTransits.simple: Ketu may unsettle your luck, travel and elders
keyTransits.meaning: Spiritual questions. Ketu in the 9th from your Moon can create distance from traditions or teachers while deepening your personal spirituality.
realLife: You may question inherited beliefs.
Pilgrimage or solitary travel attracts you.
Distance from mentors or your father is possible.
Your own spiritual path becomes clearer.

keyTransits.title: Sun in your 11th from Moon
keyTransits.simple: Sun supports your income and friendships
keyTransits.meaning: Gains and recognition. The Sun in the 11th from your Moon is one of its best placements. Income, honours and support from influential people tend to increase and health is usually good.
realLife: Income or a long-awaited payment can arrive.
Influential friends or seniors are willing to help.
A goal you have worked on for months may finally come through.
Social life brightens; networking pays off.
doList: Network and follow up on opportunities
Ask for what you have earned
Set a clear goal for the month
avoidList: Ignoring older friends while chasing new contacts

events.title: Venus turns retrograde in Libra
events.description: Venus stations retrograde: matters of relationships, money and pleasures slow down and invite review rather than new starts.
events.personalImpact: It happens in your 11th house from Moon, so revisit gains, friends and wishes before committing to new plans there.

events.title: Chandrashtama: Moon in Cancer
events.description: The Moon transits the 8th sign from your natal Moon until 2026-10-06 10:17 PM. Traditionally a time to avoid major decisions, launches and arguments.
events.personalImpact: Keep plans simple, rest well and double-check important work; energy and judgement can dip for these two to three days.

events.title: Indira Ekadashi
events.description: Krishna Ekadashi of Bhadrapada: a day for fasting or light sattvic food, Vishnu worship and mental cleansing.
events.personalImpact: With the Moon in your 8th from natal Moon and Vadha Tara, it is a good day to fast or simplify food and focus on letting go of stress.

events.title: Amavasya (New Moon) in Virgo
events.description: Amavasya (New Moon) in Virgo: a quiet time for ancestors (pitru tarpan), rest and setting intentions.
events.personalImpact: It seeds new beginnings in your 10th house from Moon (career, status and reputation); set intentions there.

events.title: Sharad Navratri begins
events.description: Nine nights of the Divine Mother (Durga), a powerful time for spiritual practice.
events.personalImpact: For you the Moon is in your 10th from natal Moon (career, status and reputation) with Vipat Tara, so the day’s blessings flow naturally into these areas.

events.title: Tula Sankranti
events.description: The Sun enters Libra, beginning a new solar month; a traditional day for charity and holy baths.
events.personalImpact: For you, Sun now moves into your 11th house from Moon (gains, friends and wishes): gains and recognition. This is classically a supportive position.

events.title: Dussehra (Vijayadashami)
events.description: Victory of good over evil; an auspicious day to begin learning or new ventures.
events.personalImpact: For you the Moon is in your 2nd from natal Moon (money, family and speech) with Sampat Tara, so the day’s blessings flow naturally into these areas.

events.title: Papankusha Ekadashi
events.description: Shukla Ekadashi of Ashwin: a day for fasting or light sattvic food, Vishnu worship and mental cleansing.
events.personalImpact: With the Moon in your 3rd from natal Moon and Kshema Tara, it is a good day to fast or simplify food and focus on intentions you want to grow.

events.title: Venus-Mercury Pratyantardasha begins
events.description: A short sub-sub-period of Mercury (learning, communication, trade and networking) within Rahu-Venus.
events.personalImpact: For the next few weeks Mercury's themes colour your days. In your chart this lord sits in your 12th house from Lagna (expenses, rest, sleep and letting go).

events.title: Mercury turns retrograde in Libra
events.description: Mercury stations retrograde: matters of communication, travel and technology slow down and invite review rather than new starts.
events.personalImpact: It happens in your 11th house from Moon, so revisit gains, friends and wishes before committing to new plans there.

events.title: Purnima (Full Moon) in Aries
events.description: Purnima (Full Moon) in Aries: emotions and results come to a peak; a good time for gratitude, Satyanarayan puja or charity.
events.personalImpact: It lights up your 5th house from Moon, bringing creativity, romance, children and studies to a head.

events.title: Jupiter enters Leo
events.description: Jupiter changes sign about once a year; its sign shows where growth and grace flow.
events.personalImpact: For you, Jupiter now moves into your 9th house from Moon (luck, teachers, father and long journeys): fortune and grace. This is classically a supportive position.

dasha.theme: Your Rahu-Venus period blends ambition, foreign links, technology and sudden change with love, comfort, creativity, luxury and partnerships, activating your 11th house from Lagna (gains, friends and wishes). These energies cooperate, so steady effort tends to be rewarded; enjoy life while keeping spending and indulgence in check, helped by Venus being exalted in your chart.

remedy.title: For your peace of mind: steady Saturn's influence
remedy.mantra: Om Praam Preem Praum Sah Shanaishcharaya Namah
remedy.action: Serve the elderly or workers, keep your promises and light a sesame-oil lamp on Saturday evening.
